# `layout/page`

A page needs its title, description and primary actions in the standard arrangement.

## Selection

- **Use when:** A page needs its title, description and primary actions in the standard arrangement.
- **Avoid when:** The page is a record's index or show view with a fuller shell.
- **Consider instead:** `features/resource`, `layout/containers`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { Page } from "themelia-ui/layout/page"
import "themelia-ui/layout/page.css"
```

## Composition

This family composes `base/action-menu`, `base/buttons`, `base/display`, `base/navigation`, `layout/containers`.

Application policy—routing, fetching, persistence, permissions, and translation—stays
outside the package and arrives through the public props, callbacks, slots, or accessors below.

### `Page`

Kind: const.

**Use when:** A route-level shell with a coherent heading, actions and content.

**Avoid when:** A nested card or modal body.

**Compose:** Supply header props and compose content from surfaces and feature families; routing remains application-owned.

**Capabilities:** page title description actions; route layout.

**Alternatives:** Card, ContentBlock.

```text
React.ForwardRefExoticComponent<Omit<PageProps, "ref"> & React.RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>
```

### `PageHeaderProps`

Kind: interface.

Extends: `LayoutNavigationAdapter`, `Pick<PageHeadingProps, "eyebrow" | "description" | "level" | "breadcrumbs" | "withSeparator" | "className">`.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |
| --- | :-: | --- | --- |
| `title` | yes | `ReactNode` |  |
| `titleIcon` | no | `ComponentType<{ className?: string; }>` | Decorative glyph before the title. Centred on the title line, never on the block. |
| `titleIconHref` | no | `string` | Makes the title icon a link. Routed through `renderLink` like everything else. |
| `onTitleIconClick` | no | `() => void` | Makes the title icon a button. Takes precedence over `titleIconHref`. |
| `strings` | no | `Partial<PageHeaderStrings>` | Overrides this header's own copy: the back control's and the title icon's accessible names. |
| `backHref` | no | `string` | Destination for the back control. Either this or `onBack` makes it appear. |
| `onBack` | no | `() => void` |  |
| `titleBadges` | no | `PageHeadingBadge[]` | Status marks beside the title, as data — the tone comes from the kit's vocabulary. |
| `actions` | no | `ReactNode` |  |
| `slots` | no | `PageHeaderSlots` |  |
| `children` | no | `ReactNode` |  |
